additional_checks.publisher: Swedish Government; published by Sveriges riksdag
additional_checks.title: Traffic Regulation (1998:1276)
additional_checks.version: Consolidated live text; chapter 3 §§43–45 checked as applicable 13 October 2026
additional_checks.locator: Chapter 3 §45: maximum permitted road speed ≤50, approaching-driver duty and bus caution; §43: safe edge/lateral movement and facilitating observed lane entry
additional_checks.excerpt: utan fara eller onödigt hinder; anpassa hastigheten så att inkörningen underlättas; 50 kilometer i timmen eller lägre
additional_checks.supports: Special bus-stop departure duty at road limits ≤50; no such special duty at 70, but safe-entry and speed-adaptation/cooperation duties remain.
additional_checks.fallback_reason: Inspected TS/TRV results did not establish the complete current 50/70 comparison and reciprocal duties. The current statutory provisions give exact primary legal support.
additional_checks.scope_limits: Ordinary departure from roadside bus stop into the approaching driver’s lane, subject to other applicable controls/rules. Road maximum limit, not actual vehicle speed, determines §45. No unconditional priority or permission to force a gap. “Must give way” in the keyed answer is explained as waiting for a safe entry under §43, not an invented separate always-yield statute.
additional_checks.retrieval_method: Direct primary official page retrieved and exact passage inspected
